title: Smoked Fish Ceviche
description: A refreshing take on traditional ceviche, with the added depth of smoky fish.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, combine the flaked smoked fish, coconut milk, lime juice, cilantro, onion, chili flakes (if using), salt, and pepper.
2. Mix gently to combine, being careful not to break up the fish.
3. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
4. Just before serving, give the ceviche a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
5. Serve chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
